title: Thai Tagine Casserole
description: A fusion of Thai flavors with a Moroccan twist, this casserole is a unique and delicious dish.

ingredients.name: casserole-cut vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers, carrots, and onions

ingredients.name: tagine spice blend
ingredients.notes: a mix of cumin, coriander, and cinnamon

instructions: Cook the saffron rice according to package instructions.
In a large pan, heat the curry paste over medium heat.
Add the durian, vegetables, and spice blend to the pan and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the coconut milk and chicken broth.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with cooked rice.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the rice is golden brown and the casserole is heated through.
Serve hot and garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
